start.welcome: 👋 Ah, there you are, Traveler. I'm Lauma, your companion for builds, rankings, and every step of your Genshin journey. ✨ 🔗 Begin by linking your UID: /genshinlogin <UID> Need a hand? Use /help to explore all my commands and features. 💫
help.text: 📖 Here's everything I can help you with, Traveler. Account /genshinlogin <UID> — link your Genshin UID /genshinlogout — unlink your account /myuid — show your linked UID /myinfo — show your account info Characters /mycharacters (/myc) — browse your showcased characters /inspect <UID> — inspect another player's showcase Spiral Abyss /abyss — current Abyss /preabyss — previous Abyss /abysscard — current Abyss card /preabysscard — previous Abyss card Imaginarium Theater /theater — current Theater /theatercard — Theater card Redeem /hoyologin — link your HoYoLAB account (DM only) /hoyologout — unlink your HoYoLAB account /hoyostatus — check if your account is linked /redeem <code> — redeem a gift code onto your account More /banner — banner information /build_guide — build recommendations /settings — your settings /language — change language I'm always here when you need me. ✨
account.login_usage: Share your UID with me like this: /genshinlogin <UID> For example: /genshinlogin 901211014
account.linked: ✨ Wonderful — I've linked you to UID {uid}. You only need to do this once. Shall we take a look? Try /mycharacters.
account.relinked: 🔄 All set — I've updated your linked UID to {uid}.
account.logout_success: 👋 I've unlinked your account, Traveler. Come back whenever you like.
account.logout_none: Hmm, you don't have an account linked with me yet.
account.myuid_none: You haven't linked a UID with me yet. Use /genshinlogin <UID> and we'll begin.
characters.title: 🎴 Your showcased characters Pick one and I'll show you its build.
characters.title_other: 🎴 Showcase for UID {uid} Pick a character and I'll show you its build.
characters.empty: Your showcase looks empty, Traveler. Add a few characters to your in-game showcase and I'll fetch them for you.
inspect.usage: Tell me whose showcase to inspect, like this: /inspect <UID> For example: /inspect 901211014
redeem.usage: 🎁 Tell me which code to redeem, Traveler: /redeem <code> For example: /redeem GENSHINGIFT
redeem.loading: <tg-emoji emoji-id="5451646226975955576">⏳</tg-emoji> Verifying and redeeming your code, Traveler…
redeem.in_progress_body:
Hold on a moment, Traveler — I'm still processing your previous redeem request.

Please wait for it to finish before sending another.
redeem.success_body:
Your redeem code has been successfully redeemed.

The rewards have been sent directly to your Genshin Impact account.
redeem.invalid_body:
The redeem code you entered is invalid or incorrect.

Please check the spelling and try again.
redeem.invalid_hint: 💡 Only official HoYoverse redeem codes are supported.
redeem.expired_body:
Unfortunately, this redeem code has expired and can no longer be redeemed.

Keep an eye out for future official Genshin Impact redeem events.
redeem.expired_note: 🌸 Better luck on the next code.
redeem.already_body:
This redeem code has already been claimed on this HoYoVerse account.

No further action is required.
redeem.auth_body:
The stored HoYoVerse authentication session has expired or is invalid.

Please reauthenticate the configured account before attempting another redemption.
redeem.busy_body:
HoYoVerse is temporarily unavailable or is rate-limiting redemptions right now.

Please wait a moment and try again.
redeem.failed_norewards: No rewards were added to your account.
redeem.not_logged_in_body: Redeem codes onto your own Genshin account by linking your HoYoLAB session once — it takes about a minute. 🔒 Open a private chat with me and send /hoyologin — I'll walk you through it. ✨ After that, /redeem <code> works instantly.
hoyolab.login_dm_only: 🔒 Keep your login private, Traveler. A HoYoLAB cookie is like a password — never share it in a group. Open a private chat with me and send /hoyologin there.
hoyolab.login_disabled: ⚠️ Account linking isn't available yet. The bot owner needs to set HOYOLAB_SECRET before sessions can be stored securely.
hoyolab.login_usage: 🔗 Link your HoYoLAB account ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ This lets /redeem claim codes straight onto your Genshin account. Step 1 — get your cookie (≈1 min, desktop browser): 🔹 Log in at hoyolab.com 🔹 Open https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift once in the same browser 🔹 Press F12 → Application → Cookies 🔹 Copy the values of cookie_token_v2, account_id_v2, ltoken_v2, ltuid_v2 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Step 2 — tap the line below to copy it, then replace the CAPS parts with your values: /hoyologin cookie_token_v2=YOUR_COOKIE_TOKEN_V2; account_id_v2=YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID_V2; ltoken_v2=YOUR_LTOKEN_V2; ltuid_v2=YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID_V2 💡 account_id_v2 and ltuid_v2 are the same number. 🔒 I'll delete your message instantly and store the session encrypted. Only ever send it in this private chat.
hoyolab.login_success_note: 🔗 You're all set — send /redeem <code> anytime and rewards go straight to your account. ✨
hoyolab.login_failed_body: I couldn't verify that HoYoLAB session, Traveler. 🔹 Make sure you copied the full cookie 🔹 It must include cookie_token_v2 and account_id_v2 🔹 Cookies expire — grab a fresh one and try again 📋 Send /hoyologin on its own to see the copy-paste format again.
hoyolab.logout_done: <tg-emoji emoji-id="6152048259289322289">👋</tg-emoji> Done — I've unlinked your HoYoLAB account and erased your stored session.
hoyolab.logout_none: You don't have a HoYoLAB account linked with me yet, Traveler.
hoyolab.status_in: ✅ Your HoYoLAB account is linked. /redeem <code> is ready when you are.
hoyolab.status_out: 🔗 No account linked yet. Send /hoyologin in a private chat to set it up.
